description: This is a shell script containing tests for Git pack corruption resilience, including creation, corruption, and recovery of pack files, delta application tests, and validation of pack integrity. It is used for testing Git's pack and object verification mechanisms.

methods.name: create_test_files
methods.description: Creates test files with random content and specific labels for testing pack creation and corruption.

methods.name: create_new_pack
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository, creates test objects, packs them, and verifies pack integrity.

methods.name: do_repack
methods.description: Repacks objects in the repository to simulate corruption and recovery scenarios.

methods.name: do_corrupt_object
methods.description: Corrupts a specific object in the pack file at a given offset.
